name: deepseek-harness-dsh-vscode
description: Unofficial, community-built VS Code extension to run DeepSeek Harness coding agents inside the editor.

commands.title: DeepSeek Harness: Add Selection to Chat
DeepSeek Harness: Add Active File to Chat

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open a folder to start a DeepSeek Harness session.
[New Session](command:deepseekHarness.newSession)

deepseekHarness.web.url.description: DeepSeek Harness Web endpoint. An already-running server here is reused as-is; otherwise the extension auto-starts one here when deepseekHarness.autoStart is enabled.

deepseekHarness.autoStart.description: Automatically launch a local DSH Web server when none is reachable at deepseekHarness.web.url.

deepseekHarness.runtime.command.description: Command used to auto-start the DSH Web server. Leave empty to have the extension clone deepseek-harness into its global storage (installing/building it with pnpm on first use) and run it from there automatically. Set to "pnpm" to instead use your own checkout via deepseekHarness.runtime.cwd.

deepseekHarness.runtime.args.description: Arguments passed to deepseekHarness.runtime.command, overriding the automatic default. --host/--port are appended automatically from deepseekHarness.web.url.

deepseekHarness.runtime.cwd.description: Working directory for the auto-started server. Only used when runtime.command is "pnpm"; leave empty to use the extension's own managed clone.

deepseekHarness.submitOnEnter.description: Submit with Enter. When disabled, use Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter.

deepseekHarness.permission.description: Fallback permission shown before the selected session publishes its dynamic permission presets.
